Inventory paths, sizes, owning tools and whether the tool is still used
Confirm rebuild/download cost and backups before choosing a removal method

Use general storage/history investigation only when the specialized inventory does not answer the question

advantagesAndTradeoffs.competitorPotentialAdvantage: If official evidence confirms S1, a specialized path-and-size inventory for named AI tools could fit readers focused on local model/cache leftovers. This is a conditional editorial judgment, not verified superiority.

advantagesAndTradeoffs.breathingRoomBoundedFit: Reused source register supports broader storage and grouped-process investigation, with approval qualifications. It does not establish identical AiKiller detection coverage or tested replacement parity.
advantagesAndTradeoffs.breathingRoomTradeoffs: Preview, not Developer ID signed/notarized per current release; macOS 13+, Python 3.10+ prerequisite, unvalidated clean-machine/physical Intel behavior.
